sql: SELECT TOP 10 p.SKU AS parentProductSku, p.ProductName AS name FROM dbo.ZnodePimProduct p INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePublishState ps ON ps.PublishStateId = p.PublishStateId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimProductTypeAssociation a ON a.PimParentProductId = p.PimProductId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimProduct v ON v.PimProductId = a.PimProductId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodeInventory i ON i.SKU = v.SKU INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalWarehouse pw ON pw.WarehouseId = i.WarehouseId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortal po ON po.PortalId = pw.PortalId WHERE p.ProductType = @productType AND p.IsActive = @isActive AND ps.PublishStateCode = @publishState AND po.StoreCode = @store GROUP BY p.PimProductId, p.SKU, p.ProductName HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT v.PimProductId) >= @minVariants AND SUM(i.Quantity) >= @quantityUsed ORDER BY p.SKU
